race.title: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
race.verdict: NO WALKOVER looked a very useful prospect in bumpers and with excuses on account of underfoot conditions when well held at Newbury on his final outing, David Pipe's charge is fancied to make a bold bid now hurdling on return. Blinded By Grace and Bob Bishop are other hurdling newcomers to note, with Jevon also commanding a check in the betting given the stable he represents. NO WALKOVER BLINDED BY GRACE BOB BISHOP
race.bettingForecast: No Walkover (11/8), Bob Bishop (11/4), Blinded By Grace (4/1), Jevon (9/2), Mac Gayveur (25/1), Fozzy Osbourne (33/1), Short Sell (33/1), Nuptown Girl (66/1), El Dorado (100/1), Petit Galet (100/1)
